title: 宝塚記念の後に・革命に散る！

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: What an upset! Meisho Doto has defeated T.M. Opera O!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: The late-blooming Umamusume has tapped into her potential and risen a winner!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ohhh… It is happening—the upheaval. I never believed it truly possible.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Cinderella has run her blade through this prince's back.
Stab!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Maria! Adieu!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: …Not that we've ever met!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, I'm sorry, Opera O. I'm so sorry…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha! Never you mind, Doto. The prince may have been slain, but I am the Overlord.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: One mere revolt is not enough to topple me. Besides…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: The cause for today's failure is clear as day. Right, Trainer?
They look around to see the other racers staring Opera O down with malice in their eyes.
The number of racers who went after her is far from normal. Being everyone's target is a huge struggle.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Do you see the burden that I bear? It has nothing to do with you, Doto.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: So, what is your next move? Is it not time you raised your banner for all to see?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Banner? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: To show your true colors. Up to this point, the two of us were on congenial terms.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: But after this victory, is it not your intention to declare yourself my eternal adversary?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: If that is the case, I shall forever treat you as a worthy foe.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: But with that respect also comes distance. I won't be so cordial toward you any longer. That would be rude for someone of your caliber.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now, Doto, what path will you run?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: My path… Do I have to be your enemy?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I always wanted to run equally with you, but…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Does that mean… we can't be friends?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: This is all so sudden… Ohh…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hmm, it seems your heart is not yet set. Very well.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hear me well, Doto. I have already declared that I'm moving my pieces on the board toward the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: You have until then to consider whether or not you wish to become my eternal adversary.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Let us be off, Trainer.
Opera O turns and leaves the track without batting an eye to the numerous hateful stares aimed at her.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: A task yet remains for Doto, just as a task yet remains for us.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I cannot run like the Overlord whilst so heavily assailed by the others. But how to solve the issue…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: From this point forward, each race will be me against the world, with every racer my enemy.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Time and time again, I will be forced to break through the army of revolutionaries caroling La Marseillaise.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hahaha. Saw through that as well, did you? Of course not. The path of a king is no cakewalk!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: As the Overlord, I have to surpass these walls.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: We have until fall to contemplate the difficulties. With our heads put together, we will find a solution, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I shall arrive at the Japan Cup with all the majesty befitting a ruler for this nation!
It seems the attack on the Overlord that Grass Wonder predicted has become a real threat.
I have to find a way to help her push through and establish the foundation for her dynasty.
